notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) only - direct HTTP via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124) for robots.txt, sitemap.xml, homepage HTML, and every candidate collection page; no block encountered, no browser needed. robots.txt is a standard Shopify robots file (User-agent: * with narrow Disallow list for /admin,/cart,/checkout,/search etc, Sitemap: /sitemap.xml) with no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow of any kind, so all tiers were permitted; tier (a) sufficed. TREE: site is a large multi-brand Shopify marketplace (Design Within Reach's sister brand). The root sitemap's collections sitemap (2876 URLs) is dominated by auto-generated SEO landing pages (per color x shape x size rug combinations, per-brand pages, on-sale duplicates) that are not real navigation nodes, so the tree was built from the homepage's server-rendered desktop mega-menu instead (data-handle=new/furniture/lighting/outdoor/rugs/decor/bed-bath/kitchen-table/sale; class mega-menu__column/mega-menu__title/mega-menu__item-link), cross-checked against the sitemap for any additional live standalone leaf not shown in the current menu (found: modern-kitchen-linens-towels, a Kitchen Linens/Tea Towels/Napkins leaf reachable only via sitemap). No dedicated 'Storage' top-level nav department exists; storage-relevant nodes are scattered as individual items inside the 'Decor' menu's Home Decor column. QTY: no on-page rendered 'N products'/'Showing X of Y' counter is present in the server-rendered HTML (this theme lazy-loads product cards without printing a visible total), so qty was taken by paginating each collection's public /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 endpoint and summing returned products until a page returned fewer than 250 (confirms exhaustive count, not an estimate); evidence field cites this for every row. EXCLUDED and why: modern-table-linens-textiles (207, parent/aggregate of Placemats+Napkins&Rings+Tablecloths&Runners plus non-textile Coasters - parent-URL rule, subcategories already recorded); modern-kitchen-linens (41, byte-identical product list/order to modern-kitchen-linens-towards - legacy duplicate handle with no <title> tag, dropped in favor of the current modern-kitchen-linens-towels page); modern-bedding (627, far larger than the sum of the four real Bedding subcategories - a Bedroom-vertical aggregate mixing bedroom furniture with bedding, parent-URL rule); throw-blankets-pillows (250+, aggregate of throw-blankets + throw-pillows, parent-URL rule); outdoor-cushions (34, a narrower non-nav-linked subset overlapping outdoor-cushions-pillows, dropped to avoid double count); rug-pads (accessory padding, not itself a floor-covering textile, out of scope); rugs-by-Shape and rugs-by-Size nav columns (Rectangular/Square/Round/Oval Rugs, 4x6/5x8/.../12x15 Rugs) - these are attribute-filter re-slices of the same Area Rugs/Runners/Outdoor Rugs product pool already counted under Rugs-by-Type, not distinct category nodes; all color-name and on-sale rug/pillow/decor variant collections from the sitemap (hundreds) - SEO filter pages, not navigation category nodes; furniture-file-storage (Filing Cabinets) and furniture-shelving-bookcases (Bookcases & Shelving) - explicitly placed under the Furniture>Office nav column, Furniture per storage.md Sec.21; medicine-cabinets, bathroom-vanities - explicitly Furniture>Bathroom nav; desk-accessories (176, sampled titles overwhelmingly decorative desk objects/figurines/clocks/room fragrance with only a few incidental organizers - not a genuine storage category); accents-bath-toilet-accessories (117, sampled titles are soap dispensers/toilet brush/towel racks/diffusers/trays with only 1-2 incidental storage items - Bathroom Accessories domain, not Storage); office-accessories (325, generic office/gift grab-bag - radios, mugs, clocks, foot rockers, figurines - not primarily storage). Napkins & Rings (accents-napkins-rings) kept as Textile but flagged MEDIUM since the shared URL also contains a minority of non-fabric napkin rings. Storage Accessories (accents-storage-accessories) kept as Storage per the site's own literal category name (matches storage.md Sec.3 example) but flagged LOW: paginated sampling across the 521-item collection shows heavy contamination with full furniture pieces (bookcases, TV cabinets, wardrobe systems, etageres, consoles) alongside genuine storage items (baskets, storage boxes, storage ladders) - qty could not be split by product type. Coat Stands & Wall Hooks (accents-stands-racks-hooks) kept as Storage MEDIUM (entryway coat racks/hooks/clothes stands - primary purpose is clothing/item organization, consistent with a prior worker's MEDIUM-confidence inclusion of an equivalent Coat Racks/Wall Hooks node on a comparable modern-furniture marketplace) but flagged as furniture-adjacent.
